subject: Sandbox allowance upgrade and short trial extension for Nebula Labs POC
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@nebulabs.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: sandbox allowance increase for LLM POC

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team was excited by the latency profile and the streaming behavior. We’re scoped to run a 6-week POC that will exercise:

- 8k–12k token context windows for long document ingestion
- sustained ~1,200–1,500 TPM during batch loads and interactive testing
- a handful of reranking/eval jobs that spike token usage intermittently

The self-serve credits we got at signup are going to burn through in ~48 hours at that rate. I’ve attached the POC spec with expected workloads. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:

1) Temporarily increase our sandbox/token allowance to cover ~200k tokens per week (roughly ~1M tokens total for the POC), AND
2) Provide a 30-day trial extension so we can complete the integration validation before committing?

We prefer a self-serve promo or code to apply to the account (so we can ramp without manual provisioning), but we’re open to whatever process is fastest.

Appreciate any quick help — we’re aiming to have technical sign-off by Aug 10.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of ML Engineering
Nebula Labs

Attachments: Nebula_POC_Specs.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

Nebula Labs (Samira / Rajiv) are asking for a short, higher-capacity sandbox run: approximately 1M tokens over ~6 weeks and a 30-day extension. They will hit large context lengths (8–12k) and sustained TPM. They prefer a self-serve promo code to avoid ticketing delays.

Quick ask: can we issue a one-off promo that allocates the equivalent of 150k extra tokens per week (total ~900k) and extend the test window by 30 days? If finance needs a budget code I can route.

Why I’m inclined to approve: 1) strong product fit from demo; 2) likely expansion motion (evaluation is mid-sized ML infra team) and 3) we gain telemetry at scale on long-context behavior which is useful for the runtime team.

If you approve, Monica can create the promo record and I’ll confirm back to Samira with code + constraints (rate caps, SLO notes).

Thanks,
